title: Sunspring | A Sci-Fi Short Film Starring Thomas Middleditch
summary: Sunspring is a sci-fi short film starring Thomas Middleditch. Its screenplay was written by an LSTM neural network trained on sci-fi scripts, and the team shot and edited it in 48 hours.
why: HN cites it as an early, quirky example of machine-generated screenplays and what LSTMs could do.

quote.text: Sunspring, which was written entirely by an LSTM trained on science fiction screenplays
